Important tax deadlines and dates

4/15/2026 | Individuals: File Form 1040. Pay the first installment of 2025 estimated tax - Use Form 1040-ES.

4/15/2026 | Corporations: File Form 1120. Deposit estimated tax - see Pub. 542.

6/15/2026 | Individuals: Pay the second installment of 2026 estimated tax - Use Form 1040-ES.

6/15/2026 | Corporations: Deposit the second installment of your 2026 estimated tax - see Pub. 542 and EFTPS.
